title: Separate time-based activities in Monthly Volume Summary

requirements.summary: Display Plank and Squash as individual time metrics in Monthly Volume Summary with separate 'Total Plank Time' and 'Total Squash Time' counters in minutes, while keeping Press-ups and Squats as rep-based metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Monthly Volume Summary shows a 'Total Plank Time' metric displaying the total plank duration for the selected month in minutes.
Monthly Volume Summary shows a 'Total Squash Time' metric displaying the total squash duration for the selected month in minutes.
Time values are rendered as whole minutes (e.g., '42 min'), not as hours or mixed format.
Press-ups and Squats continue to show 'Total Reps' counters unchanged.
Plank and Squash time metrics are visually distinct from the rep-based metrics (e.g., separate label and unit).
If no Plank or Squash data exists for the selected month, the counter displays 0 min.
Changing the selected month tab updates both time-based and rep-based counters accordingly.

file_operations.description: Update the aggregateMonthlyTotals function to track Plank and Squash time separately instead of combining all time-based volumes into a single totalTimeMinutes. Return an object with totalReps, totalPlankMinutes, and totalSquashMinutes. Add helper logic to identify habits by name (case-insensitive matching for 'plank' and 'squash') and accumulate their time values independently.

Refactor the component to display three separate metrics: 'Total Reps' for Press-ups and Squats (unchanged), 'Total Plank Time' showing plank minutes, and 'Total Squash Time' showing squash minutes. Update the aggregation call to use the new habitModel structure. Render time values as whole numbers followed by ' min' (e.g., '42 min'). Ensure the layout visually distinguishes time-based metrics from rep-based metrics using labels and units. Display '0 min' for Plank or Squash when no data exists.

requirements.summary: Leave the Yearly Progress chart (YearlyProgressChartSection) completely unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: YearlyProgressChartSection renders identically before and after this change.
No modifications are made to YearlyProgressChartSection.tsx or its underlying data aggregation.
